findings.summary: M13.22 is done but the changesets leg is red: no changeset for @fluxion/schema, @fluxion/core, @fluxion/format, which changed only in test files.

Editor Arrange never passes the screen's size: buildSnapshot falls back to a fixed 1920x1080 frame at the origin, so a mobile screen is laid out as if 1920 wide and a selection jumps to the screen's top-left.
FR-LAY-001's UI half (a registered custom layout is available in the UI) is a hardcoded three-entry list; no UI code reads the layouts registry. The narrowing is recorded in no row or Deferred entry.
The property hardcodes numRuns and seed, so the nightly 10k-run setting is ignored.

When layoutSync fails, laidOut re-runs the algorithm outside any try: a throwing plugin layout throws out of the compiler; a refused pipeline returns raw boxes with no diagnostic. The FLX_DSL_NOT_YET text still says it comes in M13.
ADR-0033 freezes a LayoutEngine that does not exist; createLayoutCache has no production caller and fontHash is never supplied.
metrics.crossings, bends and ms are hardcoded 0 and the layered scorecard the risk table and ADR-0034 promise does not exist.
Small coherence drift: compare copied four times, two identical lookup types, three result shapes for one operation, an unbounded newest map in the host.
The perf leg's name must change when M13.31 bounds the write; the size leg checks a ceiling, not 'unchanged'; the bench bound uses a provisional local baseline.
The cp1 checkpoint ran after 30 rows, 16 past the engine it was meant to review.

dispositions.note: The changesets leg is red for packages that changed only in test files: add test-only patch changesets or let the leg ignore test-only changes, with a harness test.
Arrange passes the screen's size and frames a selection on its bounds; a T0 with a 390 x 844 screen.
Registry-driven Arrange choices with an options form (FR-LAY-001's UI half). Descoping it is a human decision and needs a Deferred entry; an agent does not descope it.
The no-overlap property takes its runs and seed from the global fast-check configuration.
A failing layout becomes a DSL diagnostic and the default layout places the screen; fix the FLX_DSL_NOT_YET wording.
Amend ADR-0033 to say what exists (engine = host plus cache and the synchronous pipeline; cache unused in v1; fontHash not supplied).
The layout scorecard and computed crossings/bends metrics move to M14 (row 19, roadmap Deferred).
No behaviour differs between the duplicates; share them when next touched (review-argued.txt).
The gate-text edit and the player-core size comparison join M13.31; the provisional bench baseline is re-recorded at the first CI bench run (M13.24 acceptance).
Process lapse, corrected by this record (review-argued.txt).

planDelta: Rows grew from 24 planned to 37 (1.5x). Added: M13.33 to M13.37 (the reopened findings). M13.24 depends on all of M13.31 to M13.37. Budget redesign (a CPU-normalised measure) is a question for M14 planning: the staged budget was raised three times in three days.
learned: Check a UI row against the requirement's acceptance sentence, not only its own narrowed row text: a fixed list passed every row and still dropped the registry.
A snapshot builder with a default frame hides the difference between hosts: pass the frame explicitly (or make it required).
A property test that hardcodes numRuns and seed defeats the nightly 'run it 10k times' setting; leave the settings to the global config.
